name: Loss of appetite
description: Reduced or absent interest in food.

name: Weight loss
description: Unintentional decrease in body weight.

name: Lethargy
description: Reduced activity or unusual lack of responsiveness.

name: Weakness
description: Reduced strength or difficulty performing normal activity.

name: Dehydration
description: Insufficient body water, potentially associated with poor hydration or illness.

name: Regurgitation
description: Expulsion of recently swallowed food from the digestive tract.

name: Diarrhea
description: Abnormally loose or watery feces.

name: Constipation
description: Difficulty passing feces or unusually infrequent defecation.

name: Abnormal feces
description: Changes in fecal appearance, consistency, amount, or frequency.

name: Abdominal swelling
description: Visible enlargement or distension of the abdomen.

name: Vomiting
description: Forceful expulsion of stomach contents.

name: Difficulty breathing
description: Abnormal or labored respiration.

name: Open-mouth breathing
description: Breathing with the mouth held open outside normal thermoregulatory behavior.

name: Nasal discharge
description: Abnormal fluid or mucus discharge from the nostrils.

name: Oral discharge
description: Abnormal fluid, mucus, or material around the mouth.

name: Swollen mouth
description: Visible swelling of tissues around or inside the mouth.

name: Mouth lesions
description: Abnormal sores, ulcers, plaques, or damaged tissue in the mouth.

name: Excessive salivation
description: Abnormally increased saliva or oral fluid.

name: Eye swelling
description: Visible swelling around or involving an eye.

name: Eye discharge
description: Abnormal fluid or discharge from an eye.

name: Cloudy eyes
description: Abnormal cloudiness or opacity of the eye.

name: Abnormal shedding
description: Difficulty shedding skin or incomplete retention of shed skin.

name: Retained shed
description: Pieces of old skin remain attached after shedding.

name: Skin discoloration
description: Unusual change in normal skin coloration.

name: Skin lesions
description: Abnormal sores, wounds, ulcers, or damaged areas of skin.

name: Swelling
description: Abnormal enlargement or fluid-associated swelling of a body part.

name: Limb swelling
description: Abnormal enlargement or swelling of a limb.

name: Abnormal posture
description: Unusual body positioning compared with the animal's normal posture.

name: Difficulty moving
description: Reduced ability or reluctance to walk, climb, swim, or move normally.

name: Tremors
description: Involuntary shaking or rhythmic muscle movements.
